newsitem.title: USA: Amcore Financial Q1 net, loan reserves up.
newsitem.headline: Amcore Financial Q1 net, loan reserves up.

text.p: Amcore Financial Inc said Tuesday an increase in average loans and an increase in its investment leveraging program helped earnings climb in the first quarter ended March 31 as loan loss reserves also rose.
The bank holding company reported net income of $6.9 million, or $0.48 a share, compared to $5.6 million, or $0.40, in the same period last year.

Amcore said its provisions for loan losses more than doubled compared to the first quarter of 1996 to $1.8 million. Nearly half of the increase was related to higher charge-offs at its Consumer Finance unit, Amcore said.
Amcore shares were off 3/8 Tuesday at 26-1/4.
